def transform(grid):
    mid = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid[0]) if all(r[i] == 5 for r in grid))
    left = [row[:mid] for row in grid]

def transform(grid):
    divider = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[c] == 5 for row in grid))
    left = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
    right = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]
    overlaps = any(left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] != 0 for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(divider))
    if overlaps:
        return left
    return [[left[r][c] if left[r][c] != 0 else right[r][c] for c in range(divider)] for r in range(len(grid))]
